description: Allows an app to use camera devices.
capability: Can capture photographs and videos and access real-time camera frames.
privacy_implications: May disclose visual surroundings, identity, screen activity, or bystanders whenever the app activates the camera.

description: Allows recording audio from device microphones.
capability: Can capture live sound when microphone access is granted.
privacy_implications: May disclose conversations and ambient information; use may occur outside visible app interaction.

description: Allows access to precise device location.
capability: Can obtain location accurate to several meters, subject to device settings and sensors.
privacy_implications: May reveal visits, routines, movements, and sensitive places.

description: Allows access to approximate device location.
capability: Can estimate location using sources such as network and Wi-Fi data.
privacy_implications: May still disclose general whereabouts and movement patterns.

description: Allows location access while the app is not in the foreground.
capability: May receive location updates in the background when additionally granted platform approval.
privacy_implications: Can create detailed movement histories and is especially sensitive because access occurs outside active use.
protection_level: dangerous; separate Android approval is required on supported versions

description: Allows reading the user's contacts.
capability: Can access contact names, identifiers, and available contact data from shared providers.
privacy_implications: May expose social relationships, personal identifiers, and private address information.

description: Allows modifying contacts stored on the device.
capability: Can add, edit, or remove contact records in providers that permit it.
privacy_implications: May alter personal address-book data or create records containing sensitive information.

description: Allows reading the device call log.
capability: Can retrieve call history, including numbers and timing where available.
privacy_implications: May reveal communication habits, relationships, and frequently contacted people.

description: Allows modifying the device call log.
capability: Can add or edit call-log entries where permitted.
privacy_implications: May conceal or alter communication records and affect evidence or auditability.

description: Allows reading SMS messages.
capability: Can access text messages held by the device SMS provider on versions and roles that permit it.
privacy_implications: May expose private conversations, verification codes, contacts, and account-related content.

description: Allows receiving SMS notification broadcasts.
capability: Can receive incoming SMS messages through permitted broadcast and role-based mechanisms.
privacy_implications: May expose message content, verification codes, or transaction information.

description: Allows sending SMS messages.
capability: Can send text messages without a user selecting each recipient in the app.
privacy_implications: May incur carrier costs and disclose contact destinations or message content to recipients.

description: Allows reading basic phone status information.
capability: May provide call status and identifiers such as the device's telephony status; exact identifiers vary by Android version.
privacy_implications: May enable collection of device or network information used for profiling.

description: Allows initiating phone calls.
capability: Can place a call through the phone application mechanisms without requiring the user to dial each time.
privacy_implications: May enable unwanted calls, carrier charges, or disclosure of calling behavior.

description: Allows reading calendar entries.
capability: Can access calendar titles, participants, times, locations, and notes where the provider permits it.
privacy_implications: May reveal schedules, personal relationships, workplaces, health appointments, and locations.

description: Allows adding or modifying calendar entries.
capability: Can create or change events and associated details.
privacy_implications: May alter schedules or add sensitive content to a personal calendar.

description: Allows access to body-sensor data.
capability: May read sensor measurements such as heart rate on supported devices and Android versions.
privacy_implications: May reveal health status, fitness activity, or physiological patterns.
protection_level: dangerous; scope and Android-version behavior vary

description: Allows recognition of physical activities.
capability: Can receive activity classifications such as walking, driving, or stationary status.
privacy_implications: May reveal lifestyle, mobility, and location-related routines.

description: Legacy permission for reading shared external storage.
capability: Historically allowed access to files outside app-specific storage; modern Android uses scoped storage and more granular media permissions.
privacy_implications: May expose photos, downloads, documents, or other shared files where it remains effective.
protection_level: dangerous on older Android versions; deprecated or limited on newer versions

description: Legacy permission for writing shared external storage.
capability: Historically allowed creation or modification of shared files; modern scoped storage limits broad access.
privacy_implications: May alter or remove shared documents and media; scope depends heavily on Android version.
protection_level: dangerous on older Android versions; deprecated or limited on newer versions

description: Allows reading images from shared storage.
capability: Can access device photos and other image files approved by the user on supported Android versions.
privacy_implications: May expose personal images, faces, location metadata, and private moments.

description: Allows reading videos from shared storage.
capability: Can access device videos approved by the user on supported Android versions.
privacy_implications: May expose private recordings, faces, voices, locations, and activities.

description: Allows reading audio files from shared storage.
capability: Can access shared audio files approved by the user on supported Android versions.
privacy_implications: May expose private recordings, music preferences, and conversations stored as audio.

description: Allows posting notifications to the user.
capability: Can create notifications displayed in the status area or notification settings.
privacy_implications: Notifications may reveal message previews, activity, or other sensitive content on a lock screen.
protection_level: dangerous on Android 13 and higher; runtime permission introduced in Android 13

description: Allows discovering nearby Bluetooth devices.
capability: Can scan for nearby Bluetooth-capable devices when location and platform requirements are also met.
privacy_implications: May reveal nearby devices and movement patterns, often indirectly tied to location privacy.

description: Allows connecting to paired Bluetooth devices.
capability: Can communicate with paired Bluetooth devices when permission requirements are satisfied.
privacy_implications: May expose device identifiers and interaction with accessories or nearby systems.

description: Allows use of device-supported biometric authentication.
capability: Can request fingerprint or other supported biometric authentication through Android authentication APIs.
privacy_implications: Raw biometric data is generally managed by the system; app requests may still reveal authentication behavior or eligibility.
protection_level: normal; exact platform behavior and compatibility vary

description: Allows control of the device vibrator.
capability: Can request vibration feedback.
privacy_implications: Limited privacy implications; physical patterns may reveal app notifications in some contexts.
